explication: Garden Skills is a curated collection of instructions and tooling for AI coding agents. The principal workflow is: a user gives an agent a content or frontend brief, the agent selects a skill, follows its staged guidance and optional scripts, and produces a web artifact, presentation, image, article, or knowledge-base asset. Sampled sources show presentation cursor/audio behavior and two showcase applications; other skill capabilities are preserved from the README, with unsampled implementations represented only at their enclosing directories.
